notes:
Background: LexiCore is a mid-market SaaS vendor (helpdesk/knowledge workflows) building an inline RAG capability for their hosted KB product. Primary ask: embeddings + reranking pipeline that can handle moderate index scale (200k-300k docs) but very high QPS from multi-tenant SaaS customers.

POC scope: hosted API only — ingest provided snapshot (~210k docs), build dense index, run a hybrid retrieval (BM25 + embeddings) then 2-stage rerank (cheap embed similarities -> lightweight reranker model). Target SLOs: p95 end-to-end retrieval+rerank < 150ms for small result sets, median < 60ms. Cost objective: <$0.002/query at scale (including embedding lookup + rerank).

Model preferences & constraints: embeddings: prefer high-quality 1536-3072d embeddings (open to Redwoods' curated models); reranker: small instruction-tuned reranker for reordering top10 (latency-sensitive). Wants ability to route to cheaper quantized variants if cost spikes.

Security/compliance: SOC2 required, SSO/SAML for admin console, audit logs for query lineage, KMS integration for customer keys, EU data residency for specific customers. Legal asks: standard DPA + data retention policy (30/90/365 day options).

Quotes / call snippets: "We need 99% of our queries under 150ms otherwise customers see slow search UX" — Head of Product.

Technical notes from SE: - Index size estimate: ~210k docs -> ~1.1M vectors after chunking (avg chunk length 400 tokens). - Expected RAM/IO profile: high read QPS, working set fits in GPU/CPU cached index if sharded appropriately. - Suggest Redwood Optimize recommendations: continuous batching at 50-100ms window, prefix KV caching for session-based lookups, rerank on top-10 only to control cost.

Commercial: preliminary pricing worked up for hosted API + optimize suggestions; preferred term annual commit if SLAs needed. Procurement: legal + security signoff then PO.
